title: Customer Tried Repeated Workarounds and Ongoing Sounds
summary: This topic centers on customers and service teams trying repeated steps for varied issues, with many fragments describing attempts or reported sounds but not enough context to determine clear sentiment.

positive.summary: One positive review praises the effort made to address the issue.

negative.summary: One negative review reports that even a similar vehicle showed the same unresolved problem.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews describe attempted actions across unrelated issues such as remote start, cameras, seat adjustment, kick sensor use, repair attempts, and driving noises, but examples are insufficient to assign clear sentiment consistently.

limitations: Most examples are undetermined, so clear opinionated themes are limited.
The cluster mixes unrelated subjects, including feature use attempts, repair attempts, and reported sounds, rather than one coherent issue.
